hooks.before:git:release: powershell -Command "$ctx='{\"version\":\"${version}\",\"currentTag\":\"v${version}\"}'; Set-Content -Path .release-it-changelog-context.json -Value $ctx -Encoding ascii" && npx conventional-changelog -p angular -i CHANGELOG.md -s --no-linkify --no-commit-links -c .release-it-changelog-context.json && powershell -Command "$c=Get-Content -Raw CHANGELOG.md; $c=$c -replace '\s*\(\[[0-9a-f]{7}\]\([^\)]+\)\)',''; $c=$c -replace '(?m)^# CHANGELOG\.md\s*',''; if (-not $c.StartsWith('# CHANGELOG.md')) { $c='# CHANGELOG.md'+[Environment]::NewLine+[Environment]::NewLine+$c }; Set-Content -Path CHANGELOG.md -Value $c -Encoding ascii" && powershell -Command "code -w CHANGELOG.md" && powershell -Command "Remove-Item -Force .release-it-changelog-context.json" && git add CHANGELOG.md
